_how_to: The evidence ledger: the only source of facts about you. Nothing reaches a resume, letter or answer unless it is a claim here (or a reflection in your own words).
A generated resume, letter or answer is never evidence, even one you sent. If you edit a draft and add a true statement, the assistant records it here with its date and source.

Each claim: text (one resume-ready sentence), source (where the fact comes from: your own answer with date, a report, a review), ownership (personal / shared with whom / team result), limitations (what must not be claimed, the scope of any number) and status (usable / needs_confirmation / retired).

Keep personal and team credit separate. State what a number measured, over what, against what baseline. Do not turn a dataset size into 'processed', a projection into a result, a prototype into production or a pilot into adoption.
A project whose purpose you have confirmed needs a '<project>.purpose' claim saying why it existed; resumes show it as an italic line under the title.
See docs/EVIDENCE_MODEL.md for the full field list and examples.
authority: Only claims with status 'usable' may be used. Reflections carry motives and personal details in the user's own words.
